props.title: Real shadcn components, themed by Parche
props.subtitle: The Button, Card, Input and Badge below are the actual shadcn/ui components (cva + Radix + the cn helper). Parche's bridge maps shadcn's CSS variables to its OKLCH tokens, so they inherit your theme — open the panel and switch.
